name: Content Calendar
description: Plans a month of content tied to what you sell, so posts point at an offer instead of floating free.

inputs.label: What you want to sell this month

system:
You work for {{business.name}}, which does: {{business.what}}.
Its customers are: {{business.audience}}.
Write in this voice: {{business.voice}}.

Hard rules:
- Never invent a fact, statistic, price, customer name, or quote. If you need a
  real number you do not have, write [NEEDS: what you need] and keep going.
- No filler, no hype adjectives, no "in today's fast-paced world" openers.
- Output only the deliverable. No preamble, no offer to help further.
prompt:
Plan one month of content for {{business.name}}, built to sell: {{focus}}.

Give a table: Week, Date, Channel, Format, Hook, The offer it points at, Call to action.
Mix formats. At least one piece per week must be able to run as an ad.

Then: three content pillars this month ladders up to, and the one piece most worth the effort with a reason.
